Look_Lead.Text: Choose window corners and the look of Snapwell overlays.
Look_CornersDescription.Text: Uses DWM corner settings. Windows sets the radius (about 8 px).
Look_ZonePreviewDescription.Text: Highlights the snap target in blue from release to rest. While resizing, highlights the target until you release (with Snap after resizing on in Grid and gaps). Turn off to hide both.
Look_CornerExamplesHint.Text: Maximized and borderless windows stay unchanged. Use App rules to set corners for individual borderless windows.
Look_CornerDefaultDescription.Text: Leaves corners as set by Windows and the app.
Look_CornerNoneDescription.Text: Squares the corners of standard windows.
Look_ZoneLinesDescription.Text: Outlines the snap target with dashes (when Zone preview is on). Also applies to cell lines in the launcher.
Look_PredictionLineDescription.Text: Shows a dotted line and dot to the predicted resting point (when Zone preview is on). Turn it off once you're used to throwing.
Look_OverlayExampleHint.Text: An example throw to the top right. Use the Zone preview and Overlay switches above to see how the display changes.
Look.Preview.Off: Zone preview is off: nothing is shown while dragging
